This document outlines the battery inspection I1,
 which must
 be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block

The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Heba Abd El Moneim, revised by eng. Abd El 
 Nasser Moustafa, accepted by eng. Shawky Mahmoud Khalifa general director, 
 approved by eng. Abd El-Meguid Abd El-Kawy Emara head sector of Sidi Krir 
 PS(1,2), and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed El Sharqawy WDEPC quality 
 control & inspection head sector and MPIS Coordinator.
A work permit must be issued

The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
No smoking is permitted in battery room.

Use standard personal safety and health equipment as 
 goggles, rubber gloves, rubber apron ... etc

Don't place any tools on top of battery cells (danger 
 of short circuit)

Never use the same tools on lead cells you may have 
 used before on alkaline cells

items:
Never use the same tools on lead cells you may have 
 used before on alkaline cells

Read total battery voltage and record on battery 
 maintenance card.
Disconnect AC supply of battery charger

Inspect outside battery containers for cracks 
 and leakage of electrolyte

If you discover defective cell use the 
 recommended procedure to replace with a new cell.

Inspect contact area of inter connection, lugs, 
 terminal connections, tightening and clean any salt deposits with distilled 
 water.

Lubricate terminals for cells with a thin film of 
 vaseline.

Record density for each cell and check that the 
 levels are between the max. And min. Marks. Readjust with distilled water, if 
 required.

Read voltage per cell and record on battery 
 maintenance card

Again read overall voltage of bank and record on 
 battery maintenance card and compare the reading from step no1

Compare the present readings with the last 
 readings.
Check ventilation and clean battery house.

Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the battery inspection I1,
 which must
 be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the above title block
Battery Specification
Item / Cell type | For Emergency Diesel 
 Generator | For Fire Diesels B
Manufacturer |  | 
Number 
 of Cell Per Battery | 4 | 2
Nominal 
 Battery Voltage | 24 V | 12V
Nominal Capacity (CELL) | 200 Ah | 160 Ah
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Heba Abd El Moneim, revised by eng. Abd El 
 Nasser Moustafa, accepted by eng. Shawky Mahmoud Khalifa general director, 
 approved by eng. Abd El-Meguid Abd El-Kawy Emara head sector of Sidi Krir 
 PS(1,2), and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed El Sharqawy WDEPC quality 
 control & inspection head sector and MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work 
 area is required.
No smoking is permitted in battery room.
Use standard personal safety and health equipment as 
 goggles, rubber gloves, rubber apron ... etc
Don't place any tools on top of battery cells (danger 
 of short circuit)
Never use the same tools on lead cells you may have 
 used before on alkaline cells
Never use the same tools on lead cells you may have 
 used before on alkaline cells
Tools and Equipments
Complete tool set, and glove.
Digital voltmeter, hydrometer.
Complete tool set, and glove.
Digital voltmeter, hydrometer.
Work to be carried out
Read total battery voltage and record on battery 
 maintenance card.
Disconnect AC supply of battery charger
Inspect outside battery containers for cracks 
 and leakage of electrolyte
If you discover defective cell use the 
 recommended procedure to replace with a new cell.
Inspect contact area of inter connection, lugs, 
 terminal connections, tightening and clean any salt deposits with distilled 
 water.
Lubricate terminals for cells with a thin film of 
 vaseline.
Record density for each cell and check that the 
 levels are between the max. And min. Marks. Readjust with distilled water, if 
 required.
Read voltage per cell and record on battery 
 maintenance card
Again read overall voltage of bank and record on 
 battery maintenance card and compare the reading from step no1
Compare the present readings with the last 
 readings.
Check ventilation and clean battery house.
